formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the signer's (owner) frxUSD allowance for the spender to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (PermitModule.permit -> FrxUSDOFTUpgradeable._approve -> ERC20Upgradeable._approve).
Uses up the signer's current permit nonce, so any other pending permit signed with the same nonce stops working.
The signature can only be submitted up to `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)); anyone holding it can submit it.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens", with the spender address, the max frxUSD amount (or "Unlimited"), the expiry date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the spender and the amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: intent "Authorize spending of tokens", interpolatedIntent absent (FORMATS.md: interpolatedIntent: null). Spender and amount are shown only in the fields.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value}".
